lines.japanese: はっ、はっ……。
lines.english: Hah, hah…

lines.japanese: はぁ……はぁ……。
lines.english: Haaah… haaah…

lines.japanese: はあぁ……はあぁ……はあぁ……。
lines.english: Haaah… haaah… haaah…

lines.japanese: 声には出さず、肩で息していた。
lines.english: I made no sound; only my shoulders heaved with every breath.

lines.japanese: 戦場のとどろきや肉を断つ感触が記憶の底網から滴りおちてゆくにつれ、けたたましい電子音が僕の鼓膜を振るわせていると知った。
lines.english: As the roar of battle and the feel of flesh parting slipped through the mesh at the bottom of memory, I became aware of a shrill electronic noise rattling my eardrums.

lines.japanese: 「はぁ……はぁ……うるさいな……」
lines.english: “Hah… hah… Shut up…”

lines.japanese: 叩くようにアラーム停止ボタンを押した。
lines.english: I struck the alarm’s stop button as though swatting it.

lines.japanese: 冬の朝は凍える。しかし何故だか今日は体が汗ばんでいて、僕は寝ているあいだに布団を撥ねのけていた。
lines.english: Winter mornings were freezing. Yet for some reason my body was slick with sweat today, and sometime in my sleep I had kicked off the covers.

lines.japanese: 「はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……」
lines.english: “Hah... hah... hah...”

lines.japanese: 鼓動が速い。からからに喉が乾いていた。
lines.english: My heart was racing. My throat was parched.

lines.japanese: 夢を見ていた気がする。
lines.english: I felt as though I had been dreaming.

lines.japanese: なんの夢だろう。ふと握りしめていたこぶしに剣の柄の感触。
lines.english: What sort of dream? My fist was clenched tight. For a moment, I could feel a sword hilt inside it.

lines.japanese: ああ……そうか……僕は≪召喚≫されてたんだな。
lines.english: Ah… of course. I had been summoned.

lines.japanese: だけど、いつも通り、向こうでの記憶はもう残っていない。
lines.english: But, as always, no memory of the other side remained.

lines.japanese: ただ、なにか存分に鬱屈を発散させたような形容しがたい高揚感が、弛緩した体の奥でぶすぶすと燻っている。
lines.english: Only an indescribable exhilaration still smoldered deep in my relaxed body, as though I had vented every last bit of pent-up frustration.

lines.japanese: イーグル。
lines.english: Eagle.

lines.japanese: ふと脳裏に陽気な仲間の顔が浮かんだ。イーグル。誰だ。四枚羽根……よまいばね？　なんだ、それは。
lines.english: The face of a cheerful comrade rose suddenly in my mind. Eagle. Who was that? Four Wings… four wings? What did that mean?

lines.japanese: イーグ……イー……イ……ああ、消えた。
lines.english: Eag… Ea… E… Ah. Gone.

lines.japanese: 気まぐれのように浮かんだ記憶のうたかたも、一瞬のちに弾けて飛んだ。
lines.english: That stray bubble of memory surfaced on a whim, only to burst and vanish an instant later.

lines.japanese: 「はぁ……はぁ……」
lines.english: “Hah… hah…”

lines.japanese: 震える指先をぐっと折りこんでみると、意外なほど力強くこぶしが握られた。
lines.english: I curled my trembling fingers firmly inward and found, to my surprise, that they formed a powerful fist.

lines.japanese: よし。
lines.english: Good.

lines.japanese: うん、なんだか分からないけど、なんだか「よし」な気分だ。
lines.english: Yeah. I didn’t really know why, but somehow I was in an ‘all right’ kind of mood.

lines.japanese: うん。そうだ。きっと僕は何かを達成して戻ってきたんだ。
lines.english: Yeah. That was it. I must’ve accomplished something and come back.

lines.japanese: 邪悪な亜人族の大軍を蹴散らして、王女や盟友やグレタガルドのひとびとから大いに賞讃されてきたんだ。うん。そんな気がする。
lines.english: I had scattered the great armies of wicked demihumans and returned amid the praises of the princess, my comrades, and all the people of Gretagard. Yes. That was how it felt.

lines.japanese: 僕は誇らしげな手つきで、髪や枕にこびり付いていたグロリアス・マテリアルの残滓をぱたぱたと払いのけた。
lines.english: With a proud flourish, I brushed away the remnants of Glorious Material clinging to my hair and pillow.

lines.japanese: さあ、行こう。このまばゆい朝に立ちあがろう。凱旋した“黄金の鷹”の輝ける一日が始まる。
lines.english: Come. Let us go. Let us rise into this radiant morning. The shining day of the triumphant Golden Hawk was about to begin.

lines.japanese: 僕は勇ましく跳ねおき、冷涼な空気で肺を満たすため窓を開けはな──
lines.english: I sprang gallantly out of bed and flung open the window to fill my lungs with the bracing air—

lines.japanese: 「寒っ」
lines.english: “Cold!”

lines.japanese: ──すぐ閉めた。ちょっと勇み足だった。
lines.english: —then shut it at once. A slight false start.

lines.japanese: 厳しい朝に帰ってきた聖騎士は、震える手でエアコンの暖房ボタンを連打した。
lines.english: Returned to the harshness of morning, the holy knight jabbed the air conditioner's heat button over and over with a trembling hand.
